jobs.occupation: Team Lead (f/m/d) Agent Foundry (Data Engineer)
jobs.description: Are you passionate about building AI agents that run in real factories? Join our operations team and lead the technical side of the Agent Foundry, the team that takes agentic systems from first factory assessment to productive operation across our network of more than 20 factories. You will – in close collaboration with a multinational team located across our factory network – define architecture blueprints every factory adapts to its own context, build the environment in which agents become productive, and make sure they go live in a compliant way.What we offer you - An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests- Barrier-free locationsSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .  The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions. How you’ll make an impact - You own the technical direction of the Agent Foundry together with the project lead and supported by operations specialists of the respective factories, from the first factory assessment through to stable operation, and you turn the rollout across more than 20 factories into one architecture blueprint with regional variants, so that each plant adapts a proven pattern instead of starting from scratch.- You design the target architecture for agents in production and operations (orchestration, access to tools and systems, permissions, auditability and day-to-day running), and you build the surrounding environment that makes agents productive (shared context, tool access, approval flows and feedback from the shop floor, rather than isolated agents).- You evaluate process potential together with business and factory teams and convert the results into a prioritized roadmap, and secure compliant go-lives with the specialist functions for EU AI Act, NIS2, OT security and data protection, building compliance into the design rather than adding it at the end.- You lead the domain pods across our factories and set the MLOps and DevSecOps standards that also apply to locally extended agents. - You work in close collaboration with the EA Operations DIT team, which is paving the ground for further digitalization and owner of major factory software implementation projects.- You expand our international team of internal and external experts, shape the selection of partners, and decide on platform and technology while connecting to existing Siemens building blocks, and you make the team's results visible inside and outside Siemens, for example through talks and publications.This is how you'll win us over - You bring a relevant academic background (minimum Bachelor's degree) in Data Analytics and Business Administration and many years of experience as an architect or tech lead for AI agent systems, taking solutions from concept to productive operation in a large, regulated organization.- You have hands-on experience with multi-agent orchestration and with governance and approval processes for AI systems, and you have a strong grounding in cloud architecture for agents, e.g., AWS Bedrock, Model Context Protocol, and in modern coding agents.- You have working knowledge of the EU AI Act, NIS2, OT security and data protection, and the ability to turn these requirements into practical design decisions.- You have experience in leading (engineering) teams and external partners, and bringing business, IT/OT and management to one table, and agile delivery experience (Scrum or SAFe).- You have experience with industrial data, MES or ERP systems or OT environments, and talks or publications on agent systems.- Willingness to travel regularly to our factories, especially in the early phase of the rollout, and proficiency in English and German complete your profile.You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant. As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usAt Smart Infrastructure Electrification & Automation our mission is to develop innovative and sustainable solutions that save energy and reduce the carbon footprint of buildings, infrastructure, and industries. We enable the transition to a sustainable energy system, while ensuring a reliable and affordable energy supply. That's why we are committed to creating a greener future and transforming the way we live and work.www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs.html) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens. jobs.description: Salary group B 1 BBesO (Director and Professor)/non-tariff remunerationOfficial/permanent employment relationshipThe Federal Institute for Materials Research and Testing (BAM) is dedicated to safety in technology and chemistry. As a federal scientific and technical authority headquartered in Berlin, we make an important contribution to the protection of people, the environment, and property through research, testing, and consulting. As a federal research institution, we combine science with impact and help ensure that innovations are safely implemented in practice.The Polymer Analysis Section in Department 1, “Analytical Chemistry; Reference Materials,” develops and validates methods for characterizing synthetic polymers and their additives, as well as their aging and degradation products. The focus is on multimodal mass spectrometric and chromatographic techniques, combined with spectroscopic and thermal methods. The division investigates structure-property relationships in polymeric materials, with a particular focus on material durability, recyclability, and sustainability. With the support of data-driven and AI-assisted methods, the division aims to study mass-produced plastics, bio-based and biodegradable polymers, recyclable polymer networks, as well as micro- and nanoplastics. The division’s findings are incorporated into reference materials, standards, and policy advice.We offer:- Exciting and diverse responsibilities in a dynamic, forward-looking field at the intersection jobs.occupation: Senior Consultant / Manager - Risk Management (Liquidity and Market Price Risk) (f|m|x) (Leiter/in - Risikomanagement)
jobs.description: As a Senior Consultant / Manager (f|m|x), you advise our clients inthe banking sector and financial services industry on complex topicsrelated to liquidity and market price risk. You analyze their currentsituation, identify new requirements early on and, together with yourteam, develop tailored solutions – from the initial idea all the wayto implementation. In this role, you effectively drive the continueddevelopment of your clients’ liquidity risk management, enablingwell‑founded decision-making. You assume subject-matterresponsibility, manage collaboration within the project and shape thecontent development of our consulting approaches. Your tasks: Yousupport and lead exciting (sub-)projects at banks and financialservices providers in their liquidity and market price riskmanagement, taking full responsibility – from gap analyses and thedesign of client-specific solutions through to implementation. Youdevelop integrated management approaches for liquidity and marketprice risk, bank-wide liquidity risk stress tests and quantitativemodeling frameworks, for example for risk measurement or interestrate, margin and liquidity cash flow analyses. In addition, you designmethodological frameworks (for example in the ILAAP context) anddevelop solutions to implement IRRBB and CSRBB requirements as well asnet interest income (NII) simulations. As part of your role, you alsoensure the effective integration of regulatory requirements, forinstance with respect to ICAAP and ILAAP as well as IRRBB and CSRBB.You take responsibility for your own deliverables and those of yourteam and proactively advance topics. With your strong team orientationand professionalism, you foster trust-based collaboration – bothwithin the team and with our clients. You also mentor juniorcolleagues, developing both their professional capabilities andpersonal strengths, and thus contribute to the team’s growth. Youactively help shape the ongoing enhancement of our consultingportfolio, identify relevant market potential at an early stage andderive concrete ideas from it. With your expertise, you support thedevelopment of new offerings and the acquisition of new clientmandates. Your skills: You hold a degree in mathematics, (business)informatics, physics, statistics or economics, ideally supplemented bycertifications such as FRM or CFA. You have at least three years ofprofessional experience in consulting or the financial industry.Proven involvement in leading bank-specific implementation projects inliquidity and market price risk management is an advantage, andinitial exposure to specialist leadership (for example coordinatingteam members) is also part of your profile. You have a solidunderstanding of liquidity and market price risk management as well asthe ICAAP and ILAAP frameworks. You confidently apply your analyticaland quantitative skills in modeling and data analysis; programmingskills in Python or R are explicitly welcome. You are familiar withrelevant European and German regulatory requirements, including EBAGuidelines on IRRBB and CSRBB, SREP requirements, ICAAP and ILAAP.Initial experience in dealing professionally with external audits is aplus. You work and think in a structured and solution-oriented mannerand communicate clearly. A client- and team-oriented way of workingcomes naturally to you, especially when assuming responsibility withina team and engaging effectively with different people and situations.You have excellent command of the German language (at least C1 level,business-fluent proficiency) and good English language skills (atleast B2 level, fluent), both written and spoken. #LI-LARA #LI-hybridYour benefits Insurances & Pension Schemes: Safely on the road withzeb—in Germany, you are also privately insured via a group accidentinsurance policy. For business trips abroad, there is an additionaltravel health insurance and you can also take out a company pensionplan with zeb. Mobile Work: Thanks to our technical equipment, remotework is possible from anywhere – regardless of whether you are onthe train, at home or in the office. zeb.life: Your life ischanging—and we would like to accompany you through the differentphases. zeb.life offers you support for example in childcare, lifesituation management and eldercare or in finding concierge services.Working Time Models: The principle of "trust-based hours” appliesfor all our employees, enabling flexible schedules. For permanentemployees, part-time models are also possible: you can develop yourpart-time model in consultation with your CDC (Career DevelopmentCounselor) and in consideration of your project and adapt it asrequired. Define your working time model according to your personalneeds and adapt your working hours to your current life situation. Asa contract model, Family & More offers a guarantee of travel-freeweekdays that are contractually fixed. Depending on the reduction oftravel activities, your salary will be adjusted for a fixed period oftime.
